This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, 
 which must be performed every 50,000 operating hours 
 to remove the (O2 ) from the water.

The first 
 draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Taha Elmansy, tested by eng. Abd Elkader 
 Fath Alla at 05 Oct 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
 eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. Sobhi Elbakry, and approved by eng. 
 Moneer Elwakil: head sector of Damietta combined cycle power 
 station

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance stuff should be carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
The HRSG (1&2 ) are out of service & depressurized the low pressure section
Drain the dearator and stop & put red tag on the condensate pumps

The inlet dampers are closed & locked mechanical when the gas turbine in 
 service
Disconnect the power supply for the damper actuators
Seal air fan is in service when the gas turbine in service
TIG welding machine
Grinder & grinding wheel
Selected filler metal for TIG welding
Cleaning tools & keys kit
Internal inspection for evidence of corrosion or scaling .
Spray valve plugs must not bind, valve should seat tightly
Inspect the tray banks . repair the defect
Inspect the distributor pans, repair the defect
The vessel should be cleaned of all debris or foreign bodies
Check packing of controllers and valves, replace if necessary
Check manhole gasket if there is evidence of leaks

Check operation of all controllers, they should move freely and not have 
 excessive play.

Make any necessary adjustments, paying particular attention to the overflow 
 valve and controller as this is not used frequently and may have a tendency to 
 corrode and freeze in position

Open and close all gate valves that have not been used since last inspection. 
 Lubricate when necessary .
Inspect all piping connections for evidence of corrosion
Inspect insulation

After unit is 
 returned to service, oxygen testing should be performed with more frequency to 
 ascertain that the vent setting is correct.

Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, 
 which must be performed every 50,000 operating hours 
 to remove the (O2 ) from the water.
The first 
 draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Taha Elmansy, tested by eng. Abd Elkader 
 Fath Alla at 05 Oct 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
 eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. Sobhi Elbakry, and approved by eng. 
 Moneer Elwakil: head sector of Damietta combined cycle power 
 station
Technical Data

Safety 
Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance stuff should be carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
The HRSG (1&2 ) are out of service & depressurized the low pressure section
Drain the dearator and stop & put red tag on the condensate pumps
The inlet dampers are closed & locked mechanical when the gas turbine in 
 service
Disconnect the power supply for the damper actuators
Seal air fan is in service when the gas turbine in service
Tools 
and Equipment
TIG welding machine
Grinder & grinding wheel
Selected filler metal for TIG welding
Cleaning tools & keys kit
Work to be Carried Out
Internal inspection for evidence of corrosion or scaling .
Spray valve plugs must not bind, valve should seat tightly
Inspect the tray banks . repair the defect
Inspect the distributor pans, repair the defect
The vessel should be cleaned of all debris or foreign bodies
Check packing of controllers and valves, replace if necessary
Check manhole gasket if there is evidence of leaks
Check operation of all controllers, they should move freely and not have 
 excessive play.
Make any necessary adjustments, paying particular attention to the overflow 
 valve and controller as this is not used frequently and may have a tendency to 
 corrode and freeze in position
Open and close all gate valves that have not been used since last inspection. 
 Lubricate when necessary .
Inspect all piping connections for evidence of corrosion
Inspect insulation
After unit is 
 returned to service, oxygen testing should be performed with more frequency to 
 ascertain that the vent setting is correct.
